prompts.target: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production-ready transparent 2D mobile arcade game sprite, one wooden target. Draw one circular cross section of a wooden log viewed perfectly straight on, orthographic, exact circular silhouette centered, warm honey tan inner wood with 3-4 broad irregular growth rings and a few short fine radial cracks, thick dark chocolate brown bark rim with subtle scalloped edges. Clean flat 2D illustrated mobile game art, crisp bold shapes, restrained highlights, no realistic grain noise. Target disk occupies 85 percent of square canvas, symmetrical radial silhouette suitable for rotation. Entire object visible. Genuine transparent background outside disk. No knife, no stand, no holes, no text, no shadow outside object, no perspective, no UI. Make the central growth-ring pattern slightly organic rather than a bullseye.
prompts.knife: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent 2D mobile arcade knife sprite matching flat warm wood target art. Exactly ONE throwing knife pointing vertically straight UP. Perfect front-on orthographic flat side silhouette, bilateral symmetric, centered, entire knife visible. Long narrow silver steel pointed blade with two simple broad pale blue-gray facets and bright ivory cutting edges, small bronze guard, short dark teal wrapped handle with 3 subtle diagonal bands and bronze pommel. Blade roughly 65 percent of full length, width of blade about 17 percent of full knife length. Clean crisp bold illustrated flat 2D game art readable at tiny size, subtle dark outline. Transparent background. No cast shadow, no glow, no text, no labels, no hands, no additional objects. Narrow object in portrait canvas.
prompts.knifeCleanup: Use case: background-extraction. Edit target: the attached knife sprite. Remove ALL glow, haze, soft cast shadow, colored aura and every pixel outside the solid knife silhouette. Output a production-ready crisp game sprite on genuinely transparent alpha, with completely transparent empty padding. Preserve the silver blade, dark outline, gold guard, teal grip and gold pommel, proportions, upward orientation, colors and composition exactly. Only the knife itself should be visible; no semi-transparent mist anywhere. Clean anti-aliased object edges only. Do not add anything.
prompts.background: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: background only for portrait 9:16 mobile 2D knife throwing arcade game. A beautifully restrained flat illustrated forest at dusk: deep midnight teal blue field, very subtle lighter blue teal atmospheric oval haze behind upper middle where target will appear, simple dark evergreen tree silhouettes at far left and right edges only and a low layered forest floor at bottom 12 percent. Large open empty central 70 percent for gameplay, near-uniform dark area at top 15 percent for score, dark open bottom center for launching knife. Clean flat 2D graphic illustration with subtle smooth gradient, calm muted palette harmonizing with warm honey wooden target and silver knife with teal grip. Straight front-on. Full bleed portrait composition, no frame, no vignette overlay artifacts, no target, no knives, no characters, no objects in center, no particles, no text, no UI, no logos. Background fully opaque.
